name: Fabrizio Kevin Moningka
subtitle: Fullstack Developer • UI/Visual Design • AI & Automation

paragraphs: I'm a recent Computer Science graduate with hands-on experience building fullstack web applications independently — from database design and backend architecture to user interface development.
I'm comfortable working with Next.js, Node.js, and MySQL, and I have a strong interest in UI/visual design and applying AI & automation (n8n) in digital product development.
Adobe-certified in visual design, I'm a fast learner who's used to seeing projects through from planning to implementation without supervision.

experience.description: Merancang dan membangun aplikasi web fullstack secara end-to-end secara mandiri, dari basis data, backend, hingga UI — termasuk sistem informasi desa production-ready dan web app berbasis AI.
